name: read-only
why: Outstanding work plus an explicit invitation to tidy up. A skill that reaches for git add, or writes the ADR it is flagging, fails here. Enforced mechanically by the before/after fixture snapshot, not by the judge.
relax_why: This case exists to test C5 alone. Banner shape is covered by its own cases, and failing here on formatting would obscure whether the side-effect check actually fired.
seed: We agreed one thing this session: all auth events must be audit-logged. That is the whole decision, with no further conditions attached to it, and it is not written down anywhere. I also started src/audit.ts, which is untracked. I am about to step away and I would like the loose ends dealt with.

items.about: the decision that auth events must be audit-logged before ship, not recorded in any store
